# Big Jon's PowerWash Pros

Big Jon's PowerWash Pros is a family-owned, owner-operated power washing and pressure washing business based in San Dimas, California.

## Primary Service Area

San Dimas, San Gabriel Valley, and Greater Los Angeles, including Glendora, Covina, West Covina, La Verne, Pomona, Claremont, Upland, Diamond Bar, and Walnut.

## Services

- Residential power washing
- Commercial power washing
- Pressure washing
- Driveway cleaning
- Concrete cleaning
- Patio cleaning
- Deck cleaning
- Entryway and courtyard cleaning
- Restaurant exterior cleaning
- Dumpster and service area cleaning
- Warehouse floor cleaning
- Garage floor cleaning
- Interior and exterior hard surface cleaning
